== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Yavin 4: Massassi Ruins (Japanese)|Yavin 4: Massassi Ruins]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=67679 Japanese A New Hope source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(16, 16, 638, 470)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>7221bd59e8f78538c6b40d20e4614c97f638fe4c16757e2a21bc596e1817ebf7</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
